worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.summary: Spins out a ring of poisonous crystal light: it first shakes off Bind, Wrap and Leech Seed, then sweeps and shoves nearby enemies outward and poisons them. Virulent mode inflicts toxic and lasts longer; crystal mode sweeps wider.
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.use.0: Break free while bound, wrapped or seeded
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.use.1: Poison a whole circle when boxed in
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.use.2: Grind a long fight down with poison
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.description: Spins a %2$s block toxic ring in place; every enemy caught takes %1$s poison contact damage.
Spin %1$s times and push targets back %2$s blocks. Clear roots, traps and Leech Seed from the user.
Caught foes are poisoned for %1$s, and about %2$s crystal motes are thrown out.
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.virulent.on: Virulent: hits inflict toxic (faster damage over time) and the poison lasts x1.4, at the cost of x0.85 power, x0.9 radius, +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.virulent.of: Crystal: radius x1.15 and power x1.1, inflicting ordinary poison, for poisoning a whole group at once.
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.growth.0: From level %1$s the crystals rise to %2$s power and the poison lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mortalspin.growth.1: From level %1$s the crystals rise again to %2$s power and the motes rise to %3$s.
On: hits inflict toxic (faster damage over time) and the poison lasts x1.4, at the cost of x0.85 power, x0.9 radius, +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown, for grinding one hard target. Off (crystal): radius x1.15 and power x1.1, inflicting ordinary poison, for poisoning a whole group at once.
Without a bind, the companion only spins once a threat is within this distance; larger values make it spin and poison earlier, and more often into nothing.
On: a target with other enemies within 3.5 blocks ranks higher, so one spin poisons a whole circle. Off: ordinary attack ordering.
